senses.gloss:
उडु उडु, उस्, उ, f. n. a lunar mansion or
constellation in the moon's path; (उ), n. water.
—उडु-प, अस्, अम्, m. n. a raft or float; (अस्), m.
the moon, (the half-moon being formed like a boat.)
—उडु-पति, इस्, m. or उडु-राज्, ट्, m. the moon;
the Soma.
—उडु-पथ, अस्, m. the ether, firma-
ment (the path of the stars).
—उडु-राज्, ट्, m. the
moon.
—उडु-लोमन्, आ, m., N. of a man.
—उडू-
प, अस्, अम्, m. n. a raft, a float; (अस्), m. the moon.

उडुम्बर उडुम्बर, अस्, m. (in Ved. written
with द्, in Class. generally with ड्), the tree Ficus
Glomerata; a species of leprosy with coppery spots;
the threshold of a house; a eunuch; a kind of worm
supposed to be generated in the blood and to produce
leprosy; (अम्), n. the fruit of the tree Ficus Glo-
merata; copper; a karṣa, a measure of two tolas.
—उडुम्बर-दला or उडुम्बर-पर्णी, f. the
plant Croton Polyandra.
—उडुम्बरा-वती, f., N. of
a river; see also उदुम्बर.
